intermediate.title: “Act-based approval-directed agents”, for IDA skeptics

curriculum.summary: This article discusses the concept of approval-directed agents, which are designed to only do things that their human supervisors would want them to do. intermediate.title: How well do models follow their constitutions?

curriculum.summary: This article investigates how well language models follow their constitutions, which are sets of values and principles programmed into the models. The study finds that models trained with special kinds of character training, such as Anthropic's soul doc training, have lower violation rates than those without. However, the study also notes that the effectiveness of these training methods is still uncertain and requires further research. The article assumes knowledge of language model training and value alignment concepts.
